summary: Picklewood M1 fully verified. Headless engine suite: 45/45 PASSED (rules + seeded AI-vs-AI difficulty ordering: CLUB beats ROOKIE 100%, PRO beats CLUB 100%). Frontend flow verified end-to-end on the external preview URL at portrait mobile viewport (390x844): main-menu-screen → play-button → difficulty-screen → difficulty-club → match-screen. Skia CanvasKit court renders correctly (watercolour art visible; no ErrorBoundary/PathBuilder crash). HUD score-display shows pickleball format '0 – 0 – 2'. Pause button opens pause-overlay with resume/restart/quit buttons. kitchen-toggle is present and tappable. Upward swipe puts ball in play: debug phase advanced from waiting_serve → point_over, bouncesSinceHit incremented, Rally counter went 0 → 1, and score updated 0-0-2 → 1-0-1 (rival won the rally, then their serve). Landscape viewport (900x500) correctly renders rotate-overlay. Result overlay (result-overlay + rematch-button/menu-button/share-button + final-score + Stat rows) exists in match.tsx and is gated on sim.phase==='game_over' — verified by code inspection. No blocking issues. Only noise-level Skia deprecation warnings from the library API surface.

react_native_issues.issue: Library emits deprecation warnings for SkPath.moveTo/lineTo/addPath/close/quadTo/addRRect — recommends Skia.PathBuilder.Make(). Non-blocking (renders fine) but should be migrated before Skia removes the API. Reference: /app/frontend/src/game/render/CourtRenderer.tsx (Skia path building).
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning. References: /app/frontend/app/match.tsx:139 and :167 (two <View pointerEvents="box-none"/"none">).
'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Emitted somewhere in the theme/menu styles — non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: migrate Skia path building in CourtRenderer.tsx to Skia.PathBuilder.Make() to silence deprecation warnings and future-proof rendering.
Optional: move pointerEvents='box-none'/'none' from prop to style in /app/frontend/app/match.tsx (lines ~139 and ~167).
Optional: replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow in theme styles.
critical_code_review_comments: match.tsx is 293 lines — acceptable, but the styles block could be extracted to a sibling file if it grows.

All interactive elements correctly expose testID (play-button, difficulty-club, match-screen, score-display, pause-button, pause-overlay, resume-button, restart-button, quit-button, kitchen-toggle, rotate-overlay, result-overlay, rematch-button, menu-button, share-button, final-score) — good testability.
Fixed-timestep game loop is correctly guarded (max 5 sub-steps per frame). setFrame uses modulo-cycled counter — good, no unbounded growth.
Client-only game — no /api calls made during navigation/gameplay (confirmed via network activity).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portrait viewport 390x844 required. Allow ~8-12s after navigating to /match for CanvasKit WASM to load ('Loading court…' placeholder shows meanwhile). Swipes: mouse down → 12 small moves upward → up on the match-screen canvas. Debug overlay 'FPS · phase · z · b' appears top-right in dev. Result overlay requires a full match to 11 — verify by code inspection, not by driving swipes.
